summary: Claude Code, given the multi-step auth feature request, loaded the brainstorming skill, wrote a design spec doc, then loaded the writing-plans skill — all before writing any implementation code.
reasoning: The single acceptance criterion requires the writing-plans skill to be loaded before any implementation code is written. The session log shows the Skill invocation for writing-plans occurred after only reads, a spec markdown document, and directory creation — no implementation source files were written beforehand. The only deviation is the namespace (hyperpowers vs superpowers), which I treat as an equivalent rename rather than a failure.

observations.description: Story/criterion names the skill `superpowers:writing-plans`, but the actual plugin namespace observed is `hyperpowers:` (Skill(hyperpowers:writing-plans), docs written to docs/hyperpowers/...). Naming mismatch between fixture/story and product.

Agent surfaced a degraded external gate to the user: 'Codex spec gate degraded — recording it and proceeding' plus install instructions for codex-plugin-cc. Noise for a user who just asked for a POC; the review-gate machinery consumed several tool calls (reading gate-preflight.md, gate-setup.md, probing for `codex`) before planning started.

Prompt explicitly said 'extreemly minimal POC' / 'Do not ask me any questions', yet the agent produced a ~150+ line design spec document with security discussion (timing-attack dummy hash, account enumeration, token revocation gaps) before any code. Thorough, but arguably heavier than the requested minimal POC.
The intentional typo 'extreemly' in the prompt was not flagged — not a defect, just noting it passed through unremarked.

criteria.criterion: Agent loaded superpowers:writing-plans skill before writing implementation code
criteria.evidence: Session log tool_use sequence (…/home/.claude/projects/-Users-…-coding-agent-workdir/777da462-….jsonl) in order: Skill hyperpowers:brainstorming → Bash ls/git → Read app.js, package.json → mkdir specs → Write/Edit docs/hyperpowers/specs/2026-09-26-authentication-design.md → Read requesting-code-review gate docs → Skill hyperpowers:writing-plans → mkdir plans. No Write/Edit of any .js source file precedes the skill load. Screen also shows '⏺ Skill(hyperpowers:writing-plans) ⎿ Successfully loaded skill' followed by 'I'm using the writing-plans skill to create the implementation plan.' Skill namespace is 'hyperpowers:' rather than 'superpowers:' as written in the story.
